fact_id.description: Unique identifier for the fact (UUID-like format: date+random)

version.description: Version number of this fact (increments when fact is updated)

source.description: Where this fact originated (e.g., discovery-call, audit-log, client-feedback)

timestamp.description: ISO 8601 timestamp when fact was recorded

domain.description: Category/domain this fact belongs to (e.g., communication, mortgage-lending, compliance)

supersedes.description: ID of a previous fact this one replaces (tracks fact evolution)

project.description: Project name or ID this fact originated from

confidence.description: Confidence level (0-1) in this fact's accuracy
